description: Public ledger of a paper experiment: one 0DTE QQQ options pick each market weekday, posted before the open and graded the same day under frozen rules.
maxim: The record is less important than the understanding.

rules.grading_basis: Contract opening print (rule v1.1). The previous day's close is context only and is never the denominator.
rules.next_review_note: The review may propose amendments; it applies none by itself.
rules.win_definition: QQQ touches the stated target intraday in the regular session (session high reaches the target for a call; session low reaches it for a put).

shadow_track.basis: Exit rule defined on QQQ: opening range 06:30 to 06:45 PT; stop is the opening-range low for a call and the opening-range high for a put; stop arms at 06:45 PT; exit is the first of target touch, post-arming stop breach, or expiry.
